dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals receiving damages due to sexual acts or contact, the IRS, and the general public through an awareness program.
dimensions.evidence: excludes from gross income certain damages received by an individual due to any sexual act or sexual contact

dimensions.assessment: Can be financially life-changing for individual recipients by exempting settlement or judgment funds from federal income tax.
dimensions.evidence: amounts received as damages (other than punitive damages) from a judgment, award, or settlement due to any sexual act or sexual conduct... may be excluded from gross income

dimensions.assessment: Reduces federal income tax revenue by excluding certain damages from gross income, though no specific dollar amount is stated.
Amends the Internal Revenue Code, alters the legal burden of proof for the IRS, and mandates interagency public awareness activities.
dimensions.evidence: amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exclude from gross income any damages

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent change to the Internal Revenue Code for applicable future legal decisions and agreements.
dimensions.evidence: apply to amounts received pursuant to decisions made, and agreements entered into, after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Exact fiscal score or estimated revenue loss to the federal government
Number of individuals expected to benefit annually
importance_detail.rationale: This bill modifies tax law regarding damages received from sexual acts or contact, exempts them from gross income, shifts the burden of proof to the IRS, and mandates a public awareness campaign, affecting taxpayers involved in such legal actions and federal tax administration.
